description: Export incremental ticket events from Zendesk. Use when you need to track changes to tickets over time, monitor agent performance metrics, or sync ticket event data with an external system. This action returns a stream of ticket metric events (like agent work time, reply times) that occurred after the specified start_time. Call repeatedly with the end_time from each response to continue exporting events. Data isn't available for the most recent minute due to eventual consistency. Note: This is a read-only, idempotent operation. The start_time must be at least one minute in the past.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for incremental ticket event export.

include.description: Sideloads to include in the response. Accepts a comma-separated list of values. Supports 'comment_events' to include full comment data in the response.
include.title: Include

start_time.description: The time to start the incremental export from. Must be at least one minute in the past. Data isn't provided for the most recent minute due to eventual consistency delays.
start_time.title: Start Time

support_type_scope.description: Scope for filtering tickets by support type.
support_type_scope.title: SupportTypeScope

inputSchema.title: GetIncrementalTicketEventsRequest

name: get_incremental_ticket_events

ChildEvent.description: A child event within a ticket event.
ChildEvent.title: ChildEvent

count.description: Number of ticket events returned in this response
count.title: Count

end_of_stream.description: Whether this is the end of the current stream. When false, use next_page to continue fetching.
end_of_stream.title: End Of Stream

end_time.description: The end time of the current export window (Unix timestamp). Use this value as start_time for the next request to get subsequent events.
end_time.title: End Time

next_page.description: URL to fetch the next page of events. Present when end_of_stream is false. Use the start_time parameter from this URL for pagination.
next_page.title: Next Page

ticket_events.description: List of ticket metric events that occurred after the start_time
ticket_events.title: Ticket Events

TicketMetricEvent.description: A single ticket metric event from the incremental export.

child_events.description: Child events within this ticket event
child_events.title: Child Events

deleted.description: Whether this event has been deleted
deleted.title: Deleted

id.description: Unique ID of the ticket event
id.title: Id

ticket_id.description: ID of the ticket this event belongs to
ticket_id.title: Ticket Id
